title: Coordination between ESM and EMM for supporting ISR

entities.name: Idle mode Signalling Reduction
entities.description: ISR is a mechanism to reduce signalling during idle mode mobility between different 3GPP access technologies.

entities.name: Temporary Identity used in Next update
entities.description: TIN is a temporary identity used by the UE to indicate which identity to use in the next location update.

entities.name: Periodic routing area update timer
entities.description: Timer T3312 is used for periodic routing area updates in A/Gb or Iu mode.

entities.name: Periodic tracking area update timer
entities.description: Timer T3323 is used for periodic tracking area updates in S1 mode.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification
entities.description: Modification of any EPS bearer context that was activated before ISR activation.

entities.name: Change from S1 mode to A/Gb or Iu mode
entities.description: UE changes from S1 mode to A/Gb or Iu mode not due to PS handover, with EPS bearer contexts activated after ISR activation.

entities.name: Deactivation of last non-emergency EPS bearer context
entities.description: Deactivation of the last non-emergency EPS bearer context when only emergency PDN connection remains.

entities.name: Local ISR deactivation
entities.description: UE procedure to locally deactivate ISR by changing TIN to GUTI and stopping periodic update timers.

relations.description: Local ISR deactivation procedure changes TIN to GUTI.
Local ISR deactivation stops timer T3312 if running.
Local ISR deactivation stops timer T3323 if running.
EPS bearer context modification triggers local ISR deactivation.
Mode change to A/Gb or Iu mode triggers local ISR deactivation.
Deactivation of last non-emergency EPS bearer context triggers local ISR deactivation.
